plugins.name: datarails-financeos
plugins.description: Datarails Finance OS integration - analyze financial data, detect anomalies, and generate insights.

skills.name: dr-anomalies-report
skills.description: Detect data anomalies and generate a comprehensive data-quality Excel WORKBOOK from Finance OS tables, computed over the table's ALL-TIME history (use the anomalies skill for a chat-only answer scoped to the latest fiscal year — the two baselines differ by design, so counts won't match). The MCP tools return baseline aggregates only; this skill derives findings, severity buckets, and the Data Quality Score client-side, then writes a multi-sheet workbook. Self-contained — pass --table-id to target a table directly, or it discovers the financials table on its own; no profile or setup step required.
headings: Analyze specific table for critical issues only
skills.description_zh: 对Finance OS表全部历史检测数据异常，客户端依据MCP基准聚合计算发现、严重度和质量评分，生成多表Excel质量工作簿；与仅最近完整财年聊天分析采用不同基准。

skills.name: dr-anomalies
skills.description: Detect data anomalies in one Datarails Finance OS table and answer IN CHAT — severity-ranked outliers, duplicates, missing/null rates, rare values — scoped to the latest complete fiscal year. Writes no file (use the anomalies-report skill for an Excel workbook; use the profile skill for unscoped whole-history statistics). The MCP profiling and aggregation tools return baseline aggregates only (raw rows come from the separate get_data_by_* calls); this skill computes the findings client-side.
skills.description_zh: 对单个Datarails Finance OS表最近完整财年检测异常值、重复、缺失及稀有值，客户端计算严重度排序并在聊天回答，不生成文件。

skills.name: dr-audit
skills.description: Generate an audit-support evidence package over FinanceOS data - completeness, reconciliation, mapping-integrity, and substantive-sample checks with a PDF report and Excel evidence workbook. Not a SOX certification - access-control, change-management, and IT-general-control evidence is out of scope.
headings: Data-side evidence for a SOX 404 program
Year-end evidence package — in-scope control families only
Regular check of completeness, reconciliation, and mapping controls
skills.description_zh: 基于Finance OS生成完整性、对账、映射一致性与实质样本审计支持证据，交付PDF和Excel；不提供SOX认证，访问控制、变更管理与IT通用控制不在范围内。

skills.name: dr-dashboard
skills.description: Executive KPI dashboard — a ONE-MONTH metrics snapshot for the latest closed month (not real-time; the in-progress month is excluded) — Excel dashboard + single-slide PowerPoint one-pager. For a full-fiscal-year narrative deck use insights; for a year-long analysis workbook use intelligence; for a raw data export use extract.
headings: Generate dashboard for the latest closed month
Share Excel for details, PowerPoint for overview
skills.description_zh: 对最新已关闭月份生成KPI快照，排除进行中月份，交付Excel仪表板和单页PowerPoint；完整财年叙事和分析另用insights或intelligence。

skills.name: dr-departments
skills.description: Analyze P&L and performance by department. Creates departmental reports and comparative analysis with Excel and PowerPoint outputs.
skills.description_zh: 按部门分析损益和绩效，生成部门报告与比较分析，输出Excel与PowerPoint。

skills.name: dr-drilldown
skills.description: Drill down on a cell in the Datarails Excel Add-in to see underlying detail — also the skill to use when the user asks to "explain the variance", "explain this number", "what's driving this", "what's behind this cell", or break a figure into its line items. In a live Excel context (add-in agent bridge available) DR formula cells drill through the add-in's own drill-down; with an .xlsx file (Claude Code) it resolves DR.GET formulas, reads hidden "dr control" filters, queries Datarails, and validates totals; with no workbook at all, the user can paste a DR.GET formula or give structured filters (no-file mode). Self-contained — discovers the client's financials table and fields on its own, no profile or setup step required.
headings: Phase 1 - Resolve the Cell to DR.GET Parameters
Phase 2 - Read the "dr control" Hidden Sheet for Global Filters
Phase 3 - Query Datarails for the Breakdown
Example 2: Drill down by specific field
skills.description_zh: 下钻Datarails单元格解释数字或差异，实时Excel使用插件下钻，文件模式解析DR.GET与隐藏过滤条件后查询核对，也支持直接提供公式或结构化条件。

skills.name: dr-expense-analysis
skills.description: Top expense categories, monthly expense trends, and concentration analysis from real aggregated data. Self-contained — discovers the client's financials table and fields itself, no profile or setup step required.
headings: Step 2: Discover the financials table and its fields
Step 3: Pull totals by expense category
skills.description_zh: 从真实聚合数据分析主要费用类别、月度趋势和集中度，自动发现客户财务表与字段。

skills.name: dr-extract
skills.description: Extract validated financial data from Datarails Finance OS to Excel — a RAW FULL-YEAR export — a 4-sheet workbook (P&L, Balance Sheet, KPIs including SaaS metrics where sourceable from the org's data, and validation checks); no analysis or narrative. For an analyzed workbook use intelligence; for an executive deck use insights. Self-contained — discovers the client's tables and fields on its own, no profile or setup step required.
headings: Step 2: Discover the financials table, its fields, and (if present) a KPI table
skills.description_zh: 从Datarails导出经过核验的完整年度原始财务数据，生成损益、资产负债、可获取KPI与校验四表Excel，不提供分析或叙事。

skills.name: dr-financial-summary
skills.description: Quick snapshot of revenue, expenses, gross profit, and margin from real aggregated totals. Self-contained — discovers the client's financials table and fields on its own, no profile or setup step required.
headings: Step 2: Discover the financials table and its fields
Step 3: Aggregate totals by account category
skills.description_zh: 根据真实聚合总额快速汇总收入、费用、毛利及利润率，自动发现财务表和字段。

skills.name: dr-forecast-variance
skills.description: Analyze budget vs forecast vs actual variances. Compares multi-scenario financial data for planning and performance review.
headings: Step 0 — Verify Excel context (always first in Excel context)
Step 1b — Resolve the scenario domain and the plan side (never assume `Budget` exists)
Step 2b — Confirm comparison, granularity AND layout (before any write)
Step 3 — Pull data using the discovered dimensions (in parallel)
Step 4 — Write per-row commentary and source refs
Step 5 — Build the Sources sheet and Read Me block
Step 6 — Drill-down menu (mandatory in Excel context — do not skip)
skills.description_zh: 比较预算、预测与实际的多情景财务差异，用于规划与绩效审查。

skills.name: dr-get-formula
skills.description: Generate Excel workbooks with DR.GET formulas that pull live financial data from Datarails. Creates P&L templates, budget models, and variance reports with validated dimension values. Self-contained — discovers the client's financials table and fields on its own, no profile or setup step required.
headings: CRITICAL: Pin the `Value` token with a defined name
CRITICAL: DR.GET Formulas Must Be Simple
skills.description_zh: 生成带DR.GET公式的Excel工作簿，实时拉取Datarails财务数据，建立损益、预算与差异模板，并验证维度值。

skills.name: dr-insights
skills.description: Executive-ready insights with trend analysis and visualizations — a FULL-FISCAL-YEAR narrative deck — multi-slide PowerPoint presentation plus a supporting Excel data book. For a one-month KPI snapshot use dashboard; for a 10-sheet analysis workbook (no PowerPoint) use intelligence.
skills.description_zh: 为完整财年生成管理层趋势洞察与可视化叙事，交付多页PowerPoint和支撑Excel数据册。

skills.name: dr-intelligence
skills.description: Comprehensive FP&A financial-analysis intelligence workbook for a FULL FISCAL YEAR — Excel, up to 10 sheets, with ranked auto-detected insights, findings and recommendations, and professional formatting; no PowerPoint. For a one-month KPI snapshot use dashboard; for an executive deck use insights. Self-contained — discovers the client's tables and fields on its own, no profile or setup step required.
headings: Step 2: Discover the financials table, its fields, and (if present) a KPI table
skills.description_zh: 为完整财年生成最多10表的FP&A分析Excel，自动识别并排序洞察、发现与建议，提供专业格式，不生成PowerPoint。

skills.name: dr-profile
skills.description: Profile Datarails Finance OS table fields — how is a field distributed? Per-field statistics over the table's whole history — ranges, approximate percentiles, null rates, cardinality interpretation, and range-outlier flags — no severity ranking, no period scope. The MCP tools return baseline aggregates (SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/COUNT for numeric, distinct-value samples for categorical); this skill derives the statistics client-side. For severity-ranked data-quality findings scoped to the latest fiscal year, use the anomalies skill.
headings: Step 2: Resolve the table, then gather baseline aggregates
skills.description_zh: 分析Datarails字段全历史分布，客户端推导范围、近似分位、空值率、基数和区间异常标记；不按时期筛选或排序严重度，财年异常另用anomalies。

skills.name: dr-query
skills.description: Query Datarails Finance OS tables with filters. Fetch specific records or page through rows for investigation. The filter API supports value-list AND advanced operators — comparisons, ranges, text matching, null checks, and date ranges all work.
headings: Step 2: Resolve the table and its fields
skills.description_zh: 按值列表、比较、范围、文本、空值和日期等条件查询Datarails表，获取特定记录或分页调查。

skills.name: dr-reconcile
skills.description: Whole-period consistency WORKBOOK - run independent-source checks across Finance OS data (cross-endpoint agreement, balance-sheet identity, cross-grain roll-ups, scenario/period integrity). Validates the data pipeline and mappings, not source systems. NOT a per-metric layer comparison - that is the dev-only cross-layer-reconcile harness.
headings: How the checks source their numbers
skills.description_zh: 生成全时期一致性核对工作簿，检查Finance OS端点一致、资产负债恒等式、跨粒度汇总及情景时期完整性，验证管道和映射，不验证源系统或逐指标分层。

skills.name: dr-revenue-trends
skills.description: Revenue trends, growth rates, and composition from real aggregated monthly data. Self-contained — discovers the client's financials table and fields itself, no profile or setup step required.
headings: Step 2: Discover the financials table and its fields
Step 4: Pull revenue composition (optional, if `--breakdown` or
skills.description_zh: 根据真实月度聚合分析收入趋势、增长率与构成，自动发现财务表和字段。

skills.name: dr-tables
skills.description: List and explore Datarails Finance OS tables — discover what data is available and view one table's SCHEMA (fields, types, distinct values of a field) to understand its structure. For per-field STATISTICS (ranges, percentiles, null rates, cardinality) use the profile skill. Works with or without an open workbook — in Excel, "list my Datarails tables/models/fields" still routes HERE via the MCP connector (the Excel bridge's agent.list_functions lists workbook widgets, not org tables).
skills.description_zh: 列出和探索Datarails可用表，查看字段、类型与值域以了解模式，可在Excel内通过MCP查询组织级表；字段统计另用profile。

skills.name: dr-test
skills.description: Test API field compatibility and performance. Discovers which fields work with aggregation and suggests sibling alternatives for failed fields, then reports the results. Self-contained — discovers the client's financials table and candidate fields on its own, no profile or setup step required.
headings: What this skill discovers and reports
What It Reports (to the user, Phase 5)
skills.description_zh: 测试Datarails API字段聚合兼容性与性能，自动发现候选字段，对失败字段建议相邻替代项并报告结果。
